label: A. TLS authenticated (valid chain, hostname matches, dates enclose the fetch)
B2. not authenticated: chain expired and hostname mismatch
B3. not authenticated: hostname not in the certificate (chain valid)
B4. not authenticated: chain from an untrusted issuer
B5. not authenticated: untrusted chain and hostname mismatch
C. plain HTTP URL: no TLS at all
D. HTTPS: the TLS handshake failed
E1. HTTPS: no connection (DNS failure, timeout, refused)
E2. HTTPS: the server answered with an error status (page not stored)
E3. HTTPS: refused by robots.txt (not fetched)
E4. HTTPS: page not found (404 or 410)
E5. HTTPS: redirect or another status (page not stored)
E6. HTTPS: page truncated at the content limit (no receipt)
E7. HTTPS: not attempted (dropped at the task timeout)
